description: Press a keyboard key or key combination. Supports modifiers like Control+A, Shift+Enter, etc.

key.description: Key or key combo to press (e.g. "Enter", "Tab", "Control+A", "Escape", "ArrowDown").

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

name: browser_press
